rows.label: tlk45500153_07_msg0001
rows.name:
Let me tell you about
something that happened
while I was at the baths.

rows.label: tlk45500153_07_msg0002
rows.name:
I was soaking in the bath as usual,
chatting away, when an earthquake
suddenly struck.

rows.label: tlk45500153_07_msg0003
rows.name:
I ran onto the roof naked and watched
as the World Tree drew closer and
closer before my eyes.

rows.label: tlk45500153_07_msg0004
rows.name:
And that wasn't the end of it,
either! Suddenly the Divine Beast
itself unleashed a mighty attack!

rows.label: tlk45500153_07_msg0005
rows.name:
It blew up such a powerful wind,
my towel was swept clean away!

rows.label: tlk45500153_07_msg0006
rows.name:
Everyone scrambled back down
into the baths as fast as
our legs could carry us!
